How the Food Benefit Score (FBS) Is Calculated

The Food Benefit Score is a deterministic, explainable, and scientific metric calibrated for Indian packaged foods. No black-boxes, no arbitrary ratings.

The Deterministic Principle

Every packaged food starts at a baseline of 6.0 / 10.0. Points are systematically added for whole grains, protein, and dietary fibre, and subtracted for added sugars, high sodium, saturated fats, and industrial ultra-processing. The score is clamped between 1.0 and 10.0 and rounded to 1 decimal place.

* FBS is an informational score based on label data. It is not medical advice or a guarantee of health outcomes.

The Exact Scoring Formula Table

All calculations are executed per 100 g (or 100 ml) declared on official manufacturer nutrition facts.

ABOUT US
Eat Smarter. Choose Better.

WiseFoodies is India's independent packaged-food intelligence platform. We decode confusing nutrition declarations and reveal what you are truly putting in your grocery basket.

Why WiseFoodies Exists

For decades, Indian grocery shoppers have faced an asymmetrical battle against glossy packaging and aggressive marketing claims. Products labeled “Multi-grain” often contain 90% refined maida. Snacks claiming “High Protein” deliver 30 grams of sugar alongside negligible amino acids.

WiseFoodies was created to give consumers an uncompromised, objective tool. We believe that nutritional literacy is a basic consumer right.

Data Honesty

We never fabricate numbers. If label data is missing, we openly state it is pending verification.

Zero Commercial Influence

We do not accept payments from food corporations to improve sc

Privacy Policy

1. Information We Do Not Collect

WiseFoodies does not require user registration or logins to browse food reports, compare foods, or calculate Nutrition Per Paisa. We do not sell your personal data or browsing behavior to third-party advertisers.

2. Camera & Barcode Scanner Usage

When you activate the grocery barcode scanner, video stream processing happens entirely locally inside your browser via client-side video frame recognition. No raw video feed or photos are uploaded to any server without your explicit submission.

3. User Reports & Feedback

If you submit a product correction or missing nutrition report via our Report an Issue form, we store the submitted product details and any optional email you choose to provide solely to follow up on label verification.
